# Version 4.156.0
> **Skia m156 and native views** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.156.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.100/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 previews Skia m156 with GTK4 GPU views and restored Linux NoDependencies font discovery. The preview also aligns .NET 11 WebAssembly archive selection and raises the Tizen baseline. HarfBuzzSharp revision 14.4.0.100 still bundles native HarfBuzz 14.4.0.

## Breaking Changes

- **Move Tizen applications to the new platform baseline** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp native assets now target net10.0-tizen10.0, with native x64/arm64 builds using Tizen 10 and GCC 14.2. Tizen 8/9 are no longer supported by these packages. Retarget applications to Tizen 10 and use matching assets; native source builders need the matching GCC toolchain. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))
- **Choose logical coordinates explicitly in GTK4 raster views** — SKDrawingArea now defaults to physical-pixel CanvasSize and paint Info on high-density displays. Set IgnorePixelScaling=true to paint in logical coordinates while retaining physical-resolution backing pixels. RawInfo stays physical and GTK input coordinates remain logical. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))

## Engine

- **Skia milestone m156** — Updates the renderer to m156 without adding managed bindings in the milestone sync. HarfBuzzSharp advances to the .100 package revision bucket while native HarfBuzz remains 14.4.0. ([#5247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5247))

## API Surface

- **GTK4 GL-backed canvas** — Adds SKGLArea with PaintSurface, CanvasSize, GRContext, EnableRenderLoop, and IgnorePixelScaling. GTK owns the GL context; use QueueRender to invalidate. The render loop defaults off, and manually bundled GTK runtimes must include libepoxy. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux NoDependencies finds installed fonts again** — Restores directory-backed default font discovery without introducing fontconfig. The default scan root is /usr/share/fonts, subject to a build override; absent fonts retain the empty fallback. Explicit font loading continues to work. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))

## Platform

- **Matching .NET 11 WebAssembly archives** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp select Emscripten 6.0.2 for .NET 11 and later, replacing the preview-only 5.0.6 archives. .NET 8 retains 3.1.34 and .NET 9/10 retain 3.1.56. ([#5306](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5306))
- **Consistent Windows native toolset and CRT** — Windows native builds select matching v143 compiler and Spectre CRT libraries, including HarfBuzz and WinUI. ANGLE inherits CFG and security-cookie build flags. CRT provenance does not imply whole-program Spectre instrumentation. ([#5238](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5238))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.100

WebAssembly assets select Emscripten 6.0.2 for .NET 11 while retaining the .NET 8-10 mappings. Tizen assets move to the .NET 10/Tizen 10 baseline, and Windows builds use a matching v143 Spectre CRT; the native engine remains HarfBuzz 14.4.0.

## Preview 1 (October 12, 2026)

Preview 1 added Skia m156, GTK4 GPU rendering, restored Linux NoDependencies font discovery, and Emscripten 6.0.2 archive selection for .NET 11. It also introduced the Tizen 10 baseline and physical-pixel GTK4 raster default.
